## Activity

During October 2025, Market Eye Clinic recorded 376 captures. This provides the activity level for the reporting period and should be considered alongside the image-quality and grading results below. The capture total is the basis for reviewing the clinic’s performance and identifying any issues that may require local follow-up.

## Image quality

A total of 72 captures were ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 19.1 per cent. This result should be reviewed as part of routine site monitoring. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk, so that problems can be recorded and followed up through the appropriate support route. Continued attention to capture quality will help support the grading process.

## Grading

There were 91 referable results during the month. The median grading lag was 1 day. These results should be considered together when reviewing service delivery at Market Eye Clinic. The activity, image-quality and grading measures provide a concise view of the site’s performance for October 2025 and support ongoing operational oversight.
